description: **The write-guard for canonical artifacts — make TOOLS-OWN-WRITES and BLOCK-THE-BYPASS real.** Phase-1 review overturned the premise: a guard already EXISTS and is switched off. `lib/mcp-enforcement.js` declares guarded files + authorised typed tools and `lib/build.js:3963` runs a correlated pre-stage scan at ship — but `.compose/data/settings.json` is `{}`, so the mode resolves to `off`. UNGUARDED-WRITES survives; its diagnosis is amended (enforcement that ships disabled is the purest form of routable-around). Four real gaps: G1 it is disabled (a settings key); G2 it does not cover `docs/judgment/**`, where the worst failures happened; G3 it enforces at ship time only, so a whole session can go wrong before commit; G4 it verifies THAT a tool was used, not WHO wrote it — provenance is the genuinely new part, and the 2026-07-21 agent-claim-as-owner-claim failure is what it makes unrepresentable. Adds one `canon-registry.js` consumed by BOTH the existing ship-time scan and a new PreToolUse hook (complementary: the hook prevents, the scan backstops and already covers Bash/sed/git writes the hook cannot see). Registration is gated on an operation inventory — no tool can currently update a feature description/phase/tags, and roadmap prose needs a preserved-section bootstrap. Override is grant-then-write, ledger-first, single-use and path-scoped, per OVERRIDES-ARE-GOLD.
